from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List
from enum import Enum

class CaseType(str, Enum):
    criminal = "刑事案件"
    execution = "执行案件"
    administrative = "行政案件"

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its case type classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书1》)")
    case_type: str = Field(description="One of: 刑事案件, 执行案件, 行政案件")
    evidence: str = Field(description="Brief text from the document supporting this classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_classifications: List[DocumentClassification]
